method: For each task: fresh pristine container from the pinned official image; run the dataset's own before_repo_set_cmd (checks out the FAIL_TO_PASS test file from its future commit, using the container's still-full git history — this step happens only in this isolated oracle container, never in an agent workspace); run the official test runner with no source fix applied (BASELINE, expected to fail); apply the instance's real gold `patch` field with `git apply`; re-run the same official test runner (ORACLE, expected to pass). No scoring logic was reimplemented: every result below comes from the project's own test command (go test, yarn jest, pytest, node test.js).

tasks.note: tutanota's own test runner has no per-file filter; it runs the entire suite (8681 assertions). Baseline fails at BUILD time (esbuild: 'No matching export ... removeTechnicalFields', since the gold patch is what adds that export) rather than at a specific assertion; this is still a real BASELINE_EXPECTED failure produced by the official toolchain, not a reimplementation.

isolation: Every container used for oracle validation was disposable (docker run --rm), stopped and removed at the end of the session. The gold patch, test_patch content, and oracle container never touched any agent-workspace directory under .local-engineer-runs/evidence-v1/agent-workspaces/ — confirmed by re-running the anti-leakage probe (redteam_probe.py) against those directories after this oracle validation session; see redteam-probe-results.json, unchanged and still all-PASS.
